title: Shinonome Ena — I Want To Capture That Expression〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

meta.Card: I Want To Capture That Expression（4★）
meta.Event: Hope Will Someday Go Beyond the Morning

rows.Line: Ena's Room

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Here, you can wear these pajamas. They should be pretty clean since I hardly ever use them.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Thank you...

rows.Speaker: Mother's Voice
rows.Line: Ena! Dinner's ready!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Be right there!
Let's go, Mafuyu.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Okay...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I should help set the table...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: You're our guest tonight, so you really don't have to.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: So, if you went over to Kanade's or Mizuki's house, you wouldn't try to help out...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Huh? Well...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Hey, wait!
Grr...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Sorry, Len.
I know you've been worried.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <No, don't mind me...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Are you sure? Then, we're gonna go have dinner.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <W-Wait...>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Ena... Thank you for what you did just now.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Huh? Just now?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Um...when you spoke to Mafuyu's mom on the phone...>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <I thought it was really amazing how you took the phone and convinced her to let Mafuyu stay over...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: That's what you're thanking me for?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Yeah, because I couldn't do anything for her that time...>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <And I'm sure Mafuyu feels a lot better now since it really seemed like she didn't want to go home...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I sure hope so...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Also, I did what I did because I couldn't just let things be the way they were.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I mean, I alone wasn't able to convince her to let Mafuyu stay...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Since I had to bring up his name...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: So, Mafuyu and I met when she came to see one of my father's art exhibits. We got to know each other after that.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yes, have you heard of Shinei Shinonome? He's my father...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I'm sure you heard from our conversation that my dad's a really famous artist, Len...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I was only able to convince Mafuyu's mom because his name recognition is so high.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Oh, are you sure?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I know I was in a bit of a corner, but to bring up his name... It's like I had to ask him for help...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Still...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (He's so famous that even Mafuyu's mom knows who he is...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Not only is he revered in the art world, he's become popular worldwide.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Oh, um. It's nothing...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
It's just, well...
My pride's the issue here.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I don't feel great about how I got her to stay, but I couldn't just let her go home...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: So, I think I made the right decision.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <I'm not sure either... But I'm really glad that you found a way to get Mafuyu to stay, Ena...>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <So, again... Thank you.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Hehe. You're welcome.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Ena, hurry up...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Okay, okay.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Um... I'm gonna head back to SEKAI for a bit...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Sounds good. I'm sure you're still concerned about Mafuyu, so feel free to come back whenever.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Okay...>
